text:
It sounds incredibly frustrating and distressing to not be able to sleep properly and to experience nightmares, which must feel very draining. It is completely understandable that when you are struggling to rest, those difficult experiences become much more intense. You might try establishing a consistent, calming bedtime routine before you get into bed to signal to your body that it is time to wind down. You could also try practicing some simple relaxation techniques, like deep breathing exercises, right before you try to sleep. If nightmares are frequent, keeping a journal by your bed to briefly write down what happens might help you process those events later. Consider speaking with a sleep specialist or a therapist who can offer specific strategies for managing those nighttime experiences.
